01 / The author

About Manuel

Fiction, imagination and the many ways we tell stories.

Manuel Crispo is an Italian writer and physician, born in Salerno in 1986. He is a specialist in Infectious and Tropical Diseases and currently works at a hospital on a small island in southern Italy.

His literary work spans novels, short fiction, speculative narratives, and cultural criticism. His writing has appeared in Italian literary magazines and cultural publications, including ARGO, Grado Zero, Tre racconti, Rivista BLAM!, Progetto Babele, and other independent magazines.

In 2017, he published the short-story collection A un certo punto della notte with Eretica Edizioni. Between 2016 and 2018, he wrote the five-part Rin Tin Tin Tabasco series, published digitally by Nero Press. His novel Nei sentieri non si torna indietro was published by Edikit in 2021.

He is an enthusiastic reader and admirer of Disney comics and manga.

Alongside his fiction, Crispo has contributed essays, reviews, and critical writing on comics, literature, and animation to publications such as Everyeye, Lo Spazio Bianco, Papersera, and Dr Commodore.
